from repo import total_cents

def test_repro():
    # If prices are floats representing cents
    prices = [0.1, 0.2]
    result = total_cents(prices)
    print(f"prices: {prices}, result: {result}, type: {type(result)}")
    assert result == 0.3 # This might fail due to float precision

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_repro()
